snippet.title: Midnight Rogues | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Midnight Rogues on Steam:
 https://store.steampowered.com/app/5119140/Midnight_Rogues/
🗓️ Play the free demo now:
 https://store.steampowered.com/app/5214840/Midnight_Rogues_Demo/

Midnight Rogues is a superhero roguelike auto-battler where the order of your items determines how your combos unfold. Arrange your board, build game-breaking combinations, and hunt down The City’s corrupted heroes.

#MidnightRogues #roguelike  #autobattler #roguelikedeckbuilder
